sentence: One hedged IC lot risks 89,958 CNY a year = 112.5% of the 8% budget on 1,000,000, the same risk as 85.7% of the ETF book. Per yuan it needs (1,124,479), the lot returns 9.65% against 8.00% risk (Sharpe 1.21) while the ETF book returns 11.16% against 10.50% (Sharpe 1.10). That rung is 1.12x this capital, so the swap is not buyable today.
caveats: Ruler A reads the sizing face's own hedged-vol figure; ruler C multiplies the risk face's ann_vol by the same notional. They differ by -16.9% on IC (different windows) and are printed side by side, never averaged.
The ETF book's vol is its measured 8%-target implementation (it de-levers only), not the 8% target itself.
Replacing the ETF core also removes its bond/cash defensive leg; this face prices risk and return, not the drawdown path in a crash.
One lot is a discrete jump: there is no partial lot below the first rung.
